I have a voxbox and noticed it no longer illuminated when switched on lol. 

I'd rather ask first and procure the appropriate bulb before opening anything up.

Also, what are the recommended bulbs for a 120 curve multiplex? 

I also have a flat panel wall display from the old museum of holohraphy in ny which still has its original bulb for now. It actually burns so hot I had to mount the display on a separate plaque as not to burn into the wall..

Thanks

posts.author: jrburns47
posts.content_md:
Bob Hess should be able to tell you what kind of bulb for the voxbox. For a 120 multiplex, a clear incandescent bulb with a vertically oriented linear filament is best - 60 watt should be fine. They can be tough to find though. 100w runs a little hot. These will work but the eBay supplier below often sends horizontally oriented filaments instead of the vertical filament in the photo. That would mean redesigning how the bulb is usually mounted in the display to be useful.

[https://www.ebay.com/itm/272191722227](https://www.ebay.com/itm/272191722227)
